name: patimakorn
description: One command for a large piece of work. Run it as `/patimakorn:anvil <what you want built>`. It interviews you as a design tree, writes a plan into the repo, orients and researches through workflow scripts that answer every repository question with a read-only subagent and every outside question in two stages -- a searcher that returns URLs and a one-page reader per URL that returns quoted findings -- so breadth costs linear, not quadratic, then hands the plan to a second script that runs every task on its own executor subagent and starts each one the moment its own blockers land, so delegation is what the code does rather than what the prose asks for. It commits each task separately so any one can be reverted alone, re-runs every task's verify itself rather than trusting the executor's report, loops the review until it comes back clean, and then asks you one question before marking the plan done: is this what you asked for. The interview argues with the decisions you arrived holding, and writes the ones that outlive the plan out as ADRs so they survive the worklist. Run it with no arguments to resume an in-progress plan after a session ends.
